common.error_body: Try again. If it keeps happening, report the problem with the reference.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.conflict: This change is not possible in the current state.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.dpia_not_approved: The DPIA for {key} is not approved. Activation stays blocked until it is.
errors.definition_unchanged: The draft is the same as the published version. Change something before publishing.
errors.definition_invalid: The draft has errors. Fix them before publishing.
errors.translation_missing: A template misses a language of the audience.
errors.status_move: This status change is not allowed.
errors.slug_taken: This slug is already used by another automation.
errors.confirm_slug_mismatch: Type the slug exactly to confirm.
errors.automation_archived: An archived automation cannot be changed. Duplicate it instead.
errors.automation_not_active: Only an active automation can enrol a segment.
errors.purpose_required: A marketing automation needs a purpose.
errors.anchor_required: Enter the anchor date and time.
errors.move_same_automation: Choose another automation than the current one.
errors.move_refused: The move was refused; the person stays in the current journey.
errors.group_key_taken: A group with this key already exists.
errors.group_key_immutable: The key of a group cannot change.
errors.exclusive_subject: The group cannot become exclusive: automation {key} runs one journey per booking or registration.
errors.stale_version: Someone else changed these rules in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.day_cap_above_week_cap: The daily cap cannot be higher than the weekly cap.
errors.webhook_host: Enter host names only, for example hooks.example.com.
errors.group_key: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.lane: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

list.title: Automations
list.description: Journeys that follow up on what people do. Stats cover the last 7 days.

new.title: New automation
new.description: The new automation starts as a draft with one email step. Publish and activate it from the editor.
new.name: Name
new.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Made from the name; it cannot change later.
new.group_hint: Exclusive groups allow one active journey per person in their lane.
new.marketing_hint: Marketing journeys need consent for their purpose and end on unsubscribe.
new.purpose_b2b_hint: B2B journeys create tasks and Slack messages only (for example on an opportunity stage change); they send no email.
new.priority_hint: 0 to 1000; lower wins inside an exclusive group.
new.duplicate_hint: Copies the definition and the read-only DPIA and flag gates.

detail.draft_banner_body: Open the editor to finish the steps and publish version 1.
detail.draft_differs: The draft differs from the published version.
detail.trigger_segment: When a person enters the segment {segment}
detail.trigger_manual: Only when staff or another module enrols a person
detail.flag_badge: Runs only while flag {flag} is on

controls.activate_blocked_dpia: Activation is blocked until the DPIA for {key} is approved.
controls.archive_body: Every active enrolment ends with reason archived. An archived automation cannot be reactivated; duplicate it instead.
controls.enrol_segment_body: Every member goes through the entry rules (audience, re-entry, consent, exclusivity).

publish.title: Publish a new version
publish.body: New enrolments use the new version. Existing enrolments keep theirs unless you migrate them.
publish.change_note_hint: What changed, for the versions list.
publish.migrate: Migrate {count} active enrolments to the new version
publish.migrate_hint: Steps already done stay done; steps planned before now are skipped.

versions.title: Versions
versions.compare_hint: Select two versions to see what changed.
versions.restored: Version {version} is copied into the draft.

groups.title: Automation groups
groups.description: Groups decide which journeys exclude each other. Exclusive groups with the same lane share one domain: a person is in at most one of their journeys at a time, and the lower priority wins.
groups.form_body: Changes apply to new enrolments. People already in a journey keep the domain they entered with.
groups.field_key_help: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. The key cannot change later.
groups.field_exclusive_help: A person is in at most one active journey of this group's domain.
groups.field_lane_help: Exclusive groups with the same lane form one domain. Empty: the group is its own domain.
groups.field_priority_help: 0 to 1000. In a shared domain the lower number wins and supersedes the other journey.
groups.read_only: You can view the groups. Editing needs the permission to publish automations.

panel.empty: This person is in no journey
panel.enrol_body: Re-entry, audience and priority rules are overridden. Consent never is: marketing emails to a person who is not reachable are skipped.
panel.anchor_hint: The steps are planned from this moment (Europe/Brussels).
panel.move_body: The current journey ends now and the new one starts in the same step.
panel.exit_body: The journey ends now. Planned steps are not sent.

warning.audience: This person is outside the journey's audience. Staff may still enrol them.
warning.unreachable: This person is not reachable for this purpose: every marketing email of the journey will be skipped.
warning.already_active: This person is already in this journey.
warning.exclusive: Another journey of the same group is active; it ends when this one starts.
warning.restricted: Processing is restricted for this person: a marketing journey refuses the entry.

refused.re_entry: The person is already in this journey.
refused.skipped_unreachable: Not enrolled: processing is restricted for this person.
refused.audience: Not enrolled: this person was erased or merged.
refused.inactive: Not enrolled: the automation is not active.
refused.anchor_missing: Not enrolled: enter the anchor date.

end_reason.superseded: Superseded by a higher priority journey

issue.invalid_definition: This value is not valid here.
issue.unknown_key: This field is not part of the definition format.
issue.branch_backward: A branch must point to a later step or to the end.
issue.template_purpose_mismatch: The template’s purpose differs from the automation’s purpose.
issue.translation_missing: The template misses a language of the audience.
issue.send_as_not_marketing: Sending as marketing needs a marketing automation with a purpose.
issue.automation_unknown: There is no automation with this slug.
issue.enrol_self: An automation cannot enrol into itself.
issue.enrol_cycle: The target enrols back into this automation.
issue.webhook_host_not_allowed: This host is not on the webhook allow-list.
issue.anchor_required: Timing from the anchor needs an event date as anchor.
issue.exclusive_subject: An automation in an exclusive group cannot run per subject.
issue.trigger_history_imported: Imported history never starts a journey.
issue.trigger_automation_kind: Automation events never start a journey.
issue.placeholder_not_allowed: This placeholder is not allowed here.
issue.interpolation_not_allowed: Trigger placeholders are not allowed in a trigger filter.
issue.unknown_event_kind: This event kind is not in the event registry.
issue.unknown_event_path: This event has no such data field.
issue.builder_empty: Add at least one block after the trigger.

editor.title: Edit {name}
editor.no_issues: No issues. This draft can be published.
editor.json_hint: Edits here replace the form. Apply to check and update the form.
editor.json_unreadable: The draft cannot be shown in the form. Use the JSON tab.
editor.readonly: You can view this draft but not change it.
editor.name: Name
editor.b2b_email_steps: This B2B journey still has email steps. Replace them with task or Slack steps; B2B contacts get no automated email. Email steps:
editor.purpose_b2b_hint: B2B journeys create tasks and Slack messages only: automated B2B outbound email is not available yet.
editor.trigger_event_help: Enrols the person of a matching activity event.
editor.trigger_segment_help: Enrols people when they enter the segment.
editor.trigger_manual_help: Nobody enrols automatically; staff or other modules enrol people.
editor.event_kinds_hint: Any of these kinds starts the journey.
editor.where_hint: Every row must match. Paths: data.field_name, mode, ref_type, ref_id.
editor.value_hint: Text, a number, true, false or null. Lists: comma separated.
editor.anchor_data: A date in the trigger event
editor.subject: One journey
editor.subject_ref: Per booking, webinar, grant or checkout of the trigger
editor.audience_locales_hint: Templates must cover every language listed here (all three when empty).
editor.exit_on_hint: Unsubscribes, consent withdrawal, restriction and merges always end marketing journeys.
editor.exit_qualifier_hint: Optional purpose, scope or order line kind.
editor.step_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; unique in this automation.
editor.at_minutes_hint: Negative before the event date: -1440 is one day before.
editor.late_entry: When the person enters too late
editor.send_as_hint: For a system template sent as a marketing message (consent of the purpose applies).
editor.task_owner_role_opt: Least busy person in the role
editor.task_owner_trigger: The owner named by the trigger
editor.webhook_url_hint: https only; the host must be on the allow-list.

step_help.email: Queues a published template for the person in their language.
step_help.condition: Checks fresh facts and jumps forward.
step_help.task: Creates a task for the least busy person in a role.
step_help.tag: Adds a tag to the person.
step_help.untag: Removes a tag from the person.
step_help.status_override: Sets or removes a status override with a reason.
step_help.enrol: Enrols the person into another automation.
step_help.exit: Ends this or another journey of the person.
step_help.notify_slack: Posts a short message in Slack.
step_help.webhook: Posts a signed JSON message to an allowed https address.

predicate_help.all: True when every condition in the group is true.
predicate_help.any: True when at least one condition is true.
predicate_help.has_future_booking: A reserved or confirmed booking that starts later.
predicate_help.in_segment: The person is a member of the segment.
predicate_help.membership_cancelling: The membership ends at the end of the period.
predicate_help.has_other_active_grant: Another grant of this credit kind still has units.
predicate_help.form_completed: A completed submission of the form exists.
predicate_help.form_available: The form has a published version.
predicate_help.processing_restricted: A GDPR restriction or objection applies.
predicate_help.event_since_enrolment: The person had this event after entering the journey.
predicate_help.booking_status_in: The current status of the booking that started the journey.
predicate_help.trigger: A filter over the trigger event.
predicate_help.task_open: The task of an earlier step is not done yet.
predicate_help.sent_within_days: The person received this template within the days.

op_help.in: The value is in the list.
op_help.nin: The value is not in the list.
op_help.gt: Numbers or ISO dates after the value.
op_help.gte: Numbers or ISO dates from the value on.
op_help.lt: Numbers or ISO dates before the value.
op_help.lte: Numbers or ISO dates up to the value.
op_help.exists: true: the field is set; false: it is missing.

rules.title: Automation rules
rules.description: Frequency caps and quiet hours for marketing emails sent by automations, and the hosts webhook steps may call. Transactional emails are never capped or delayed.
rules.caps_help: A marketing email over a cap is skipped and the journey continues with its next step.
rules.per_day: Marketing emails per person per 24 hours
rules.per_day_help: 0 to 10. 0 sends no automation marketing email at all.
rules.per_week: Marketing emails per person per 7 days
rules.per_week_help: 0 to 30, and at least the daily cap.
rules.quiet_help: A marketing email due in this window waits until its end (Europe/Brussels). The same start and end time means no quiet hours.
rules.hosts_help: One host per line, for example hooks.example.com. Webhook steps may only call https addresses on these hosts. Adding a host sends person data to it.
rules.hosts_readonly: Changing the hosts needs the permission to change settings.

conflicts.title: Conflict report
conflicts.description: Which journeys block or supersede which in exclusive domains. Blocked: the journey was refused because another held the domain. Superseded: the journey ended because one with a lower priority started.

builder.title: Visual builder
builder.intro: Build the journey as a flow of blocks. The flow is saved as the same draft as the form editor.
builder.not_saved: The flow was not saved: fix the issues marked on the blocks first.
builder.readonly: This automation is archived: the flow is read only.
builder.unreadable: This draft cannot be shown as a flow. Fix it in the form editor or its JSON tab first.
builder.palette_hint: Drag a block onto the flow, or press it to add it at the end of the selected lane.
builder.lane_falls_through: Then continues with the No lane
builder.lane_when_empty: When this lane has no blocks
builder.keyboard_hint: Alt+Arrow up and Alt+Arrow down move the focused block within its lane.
builder.panel_empty: Select a block to edit its settings.

block_help.trigger: When the journey starts, who enters, when they may enter again and what makes them leave.
block_help.condition: Continue only when the condition holds; otherwise the journey ends here.
block_help.delay: Wait a number of minutes before the next block.
block_help.branch: Run the Yes lane when the condition holds and the No lane otherwise.
block_help.task: Create a task for a team role or the trigger's owner.
block_help.tag: Add or remove a tag on the person.
block_help.status: Set or clear the person's status override.
block_help.sequence: Enrol the person in another automation, or end an enrolment.
block_help.notify: Post a message to the team's Slack channel.
